title: Apple warning shakes European shares as chipmakers tumble
text: Apple warning shakes European shares as chipmakers tumble Thursday, 3 January 2019 ( 5 hours ago ) Apple's first revenue warning in nearly 12 years sent European shares sliding on Thursday with the tech sector particularly badly bruised as chipmakers which supply to the iPhone maker fell sharply.
